en: Use the manual to call your Argent Squire for a training lesson in combat with the Silithid. Silithids killed in the squire's presence will increase your reputation with the Argent Dawn.

Rally your nearby party or raid members, granting them $s1% increased spell critical strike chance, $s3% increased melee and ranged critical strike chance, and $s2 increased attack power. Lasts $473387d. Exclusive with similar world effects and unaffected by Chronoboons.

Summon a songflower that grants all your party or raid members $s1% increased chance for a melee, ranged, or spell critical and $s2 increased attributes for $473399d. Exclusive with similar world effects. Unaffected by Chronoboons.
Summon a cauldron of Firewater for $d, useable by all members of your party or raid to increase melee attack power by $473469s1 and size for $473469d.
Inhaling this incense causes you to fade into the shadows, allowing you to sneak around while inside Hive'Ashi, Hive'Regal, or Hive'Zora, but reduces your speed by $s2%.  Lasts $d.
Use the branch to call an Ancient of War to assist you in fighting Silithids.
